deployment_scope: Local development; no production exposure certified

risks.description: Uvicorn logged the raw exception re-raised by Starlette after safe 500 responses
risks.existing_control: Safe HTTP envelope and app log alone were insufficient
risks.fix: Logger-level exception record sanitization; DB register normalization
risks.remaining_risk: Privileged debugging and third-party collectors require their own privacy policy

risks.description: NUL entered PostgreSQL-incompatible text; UTC boundary overflow raised uncaught errors
risks.existing_control: Line/header/UTF-8 bounds existed but did not cover storage compatibility/overflow
risks.fix: Fatal NUL issue before metadata creation; safe invalid_timestamp for UTC overflow
risks.remaining_risk: Partial damage remains accepted by the original contract; issues are disclosed

risks.description: ArtifactStoreError interrupted maintenance; cleanup failures lacked safe diagnostics
risks.existing_control: Explicit orphan grace and terminal cleanup existed
risks.fix: Controlled cleanup exceptions and generic retry warnings without private paths
risks.remaining_risk: Physical deletion still requires successful operator maintenance; production scheduler is R-06

risks.description: Check-then-rename could overwrite a concurrently appearing final file on POSIX
risks.existing_control: Random opaque keys and exclusive partial creation made remote exploit improbable
risks.remaining_risk: Root ACL and hard-link support required; hostile host file writers outside API boundary

risks.description: Repeated pop(0) on leading blank lines caused quadratic work within message bounds
risks.existing_control: Body/line size bounds already limited each block
risks.remaining_risk: Finite parser cost still scales with input bytes and accepted inventory

risks.asset: Raw import data, deleted Memory and key fences
risks.description: Production artifact scheduler, bounded maintenance/alerts, encrypted backups and restore reconciliation are not deployed
risks.existing_control: Private local root, query-time expiry and explicit maintenance/restore quarantine policy
risks.fix: Local expiry/cleanup verified; no production implementation claimed
risks.remaining_risk: Missed physical cleanup may retain private data; unsafe production deployment/restore would elevate to P1/P0

risks.description: No upload rate/concurrency/storage quota or active-body deadline; per-request bounds do not cap aggregate legal requests
risks.existing_control: Local loopback acceptance, development signed identities, actual receive/file caps and parser bounds
risks.fix: Per-request bounds verified, including real default 100MiB upload; aggregate protection remains absent
risks.remaining_risk: Untrusted network exposure without admission/rate/storage limits is P1 and is not authorized by this acceptance

risks.description: Future imported-chat analysis would expose injection and unauthorized transmission risks
risks.existing_control: No imported data enters Agent/Memory/provider at present
risks.fix: Existing data separation retained; no analysis pipeline introduced
risks.remaining_risk: Explicit scoped source consent, bounded untrusted context and live evaluation required before integration
risks.responsible_phase: Explicit future imported-analysis authorization; provider acceptance

risks.description: Development issuer, pending-operation restart limits, broad deletion and deployed log rotation remain incomplete
risks.existing_control: SecureStore, epoch invalidation, safe unknown outcomes, guarded primary Memory deletion and synthetic evidence
risks.fix: Existing regressions retained; history screening and private subprocess wrapper tested
risks.remaining_risk: No OAuth/refresh, account-wide erasure, durable outbox, production collector or full native cache assurance claim
